description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. The user's job search targets: roles, seniority, cities and work mode from the website, plus the salary floor (gross or net), dealbreakers, priorities and companies to avoid saved with update_search_profile. Read it at the start of job search work instead of asking again; `missing` lists what to ask.
name: get_search_profile
title: Read my search profile
